pages.title: Ostwald Converter
pages.text: Ammonia and air through a glowing platinum gauze in a thousandth of a second, then into water: nitric acid.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the gauze temperature and the contact time. Hot enough (above about 1100 K) and brief enough (a millisecond or two), ammonia burns to nitric oxide; too cool, or too long, and it burns to plain nitrogen. The selectivity must reach 90%. Above 1250 K the gauze loses platinum (it wears ten times as fast). Needs a Platinum-Rhodium Gauze in its catalyst slot.
